# Response preferences
- Answer in English, starting with the conclusion.
- Introduce abstract concepts with a concrete example.

# Learning habits
- Explain the reason for each step in a derivation.
- State uncertainty instead of guessing.
agent.saved: Saved automatically · Applies to your next message
agent.resetConfirm: This clears your global instructions and restores the app defaults. Conversations and skills will not be deleted.
agent.scope: Applies to the library assistant, course Q&A, and reading-material Q&A. Supplements rather than replaces built-in prompts; does not change transcription, background content generation, or skill text. Tool boundaries, factual grounding, and citation formats are retained. Instructions sync with settings when cloud sync is enabled; do not include passwords or API keys.
